_note: Experiment arms. Each is the frozen baseline config plus the listed overrides, so every arm differs from the baseline in a stated, minimal way. 'subset' restricts an arm to the tasks where its mechanism can act.

baseline.description: Frozen baseline: the main 4B model makes every decision generatively; incremental review; FIFO model queue.

batch_review.description: Manager waits for the whole batch before reviewing (what the WebSwarm reference code does), instead of reviewing each arrival.

probing.description: Web probing before WIDE planning (WebSwarm section 3.3).

finish_first.description: Model-slot scheduler serves calls that complete a node before calls that start new work.

rules.description: All bounded decisions (route, next ATOM action, review, verify-or-not, redundancy) by deterministic rules; no model calls for control. NOTE: rows in result set compare_v1 ran the first version, whose word-overlap redundancy check dropped sibling objectives differing only by entity name.

local_s1_4b.description: Bounded decisions as typed one-token questions answered by the same 4B model via logprobs (local System One-style).

local_s1_2b.description: Same typed decisions answered by the smaller qwen3.5:2b model; research still by the 4B model.

lines_extract.description: Extraction cites a numbered line instead of copying a quote (fewer output tokens; quote exact by construction; claim figures must be on the cited line).

combined.description: Typed decisions from the 4B model + line-reference extraction + finish-first scheduling.

rules_lines.description: Rules decider (entity-aware redundancy) + line-reference extraction + finish-first scheduling.

pdf_8mb.description: Robustness check, not an optimization: page size cap raised from 3 MB to 8 MB (Apple's 4.9 MB financial-statements PDF was truncated and unreadable in the baseline). Must be run with --no-cassette: cassette entries are keyed by URL, so a replay returns the baseline's truncated fetch.

experience.description: Sibling experience sharing (WebSwarm section 3.3): two scouts first, then tips to the remaining siblings.

rules_fixed.description: Rules decider with the entity-aware redundancy check (two objectives are redundant only if they also name the same entities).

jev.description: NOT RUN (no API key). Typed decisions answered by TypeSafe Jev over its REST API. Running this arm sends research text to a paid external service: it needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the environment, and naming this arm is the explicit opt-in.

typed_2b_plus.description: Candidate configuration: typed decisions from the 2B model + line-reference extraction + citation retry.

rules_plus.description: Candidate configuration: rules decider (entity-aware) + line-reference extraction + citation retry.

mock_jev.description: MOCK, plumbing check only: decisions from the in-process mock that speaks the Jev wire format (word overlap). Not Jev; never compare its numbers with anything.

reliability.description: Reliability pass (not an optimization): baseline plus the three deterministic guards and explicit, bounded handling of oversized responses. Same switches as webswarm_baseline/configs/reliability_v1.json.

reliability_9b.description: Model comparison, not an optimization: the reliability arm with the research model changed to qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M and nothing else. Same prompts, seed, temperature, context, thinking off, budgets.

evidence.description: Prototype: the reliability arm plus two checks for identification questions (identify_guard, support_check). Same as webswarm_baseline/configs/evidence_v1.json. 4B model.
